text: on the apis with many sports books, I noticed that sometimes I'll get positive EV results based on 2 or 3 small sports books that have the exact same odds. they may use the same odds source and are double counted. for the GitHub engine auto bid and auto bet, build a guard where it won't place bets or make bids based on fair odds calculations that are based on only a small number of small sports books with identical odds. favor large brands sports books and odds that are similar among them but not necessarily identical. make sure to exclude from any fair odds calculation anywhere in the app or the engine any sports book that shows odds that are likely wrong or stale based on outlier numbers
